note: Six active stations have fictional campaign contacts on London maps. Real broadcasters are unaffiliated; contact locations and activities are invented for The Smoke. The two unverified stations and their optional map contacts have been retired.

locations.title: Point Blank · Eagle Wharf promo lockup
locations.pitch: A quiet producer's room under the Wharf. Get the late sets heard before the suits buy the dial.
locations.task: Run flyers and collect street requests for the underground lineup.

locations.title: Rude FM · Dalston aerial contact
locations.pitch: An upstairs signal runner needs help keeping the jungle sound alive. Mind the rival promoters.
locations.task: Repair the receiver and carry the evening set to the next relay.

locations.title: Vision Radio UK · Shacklewell promoter
locations.pitch: A booking contact is trying to stay above board while rival flyers cover every wall.
locations.task: Secure legitimate venue slots and keep the weekend broadcast going.

locations.title: Flex FM · Clarence Road listening point
locations.pitch: The listening point knows what everyone in the borough is playing. Get a tune on before the competition.
locations.task: Take listener votes, test the aerial and deliver the results.

locations.title: Supreme FM · Broadway Market showcase
locations.pitch: Community radio has a stall here. They've got a stage to fill and a signal to protect.
locations.task: Organise the showcase and keep the sponsor's people happy.

locations.title: Radio Caroline · Marshgate listening post
locations.pitch: A London relay contact holds the old-school broadcast archive. Its history is worth something to both sides.
locations.task: Recover a missing recording and help the listening post stay on air.
